palette_rationale: Preserve approved grey-blue striped pelt, yellow body, pink claws, red source eyes, and turquoise belly mark within the 63-color Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr151 model and native clips; PMDO engine registry supplies action names, durations and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Fixed grounded row-47 shadow; keep native crouch, recoil and Hop lift rather than normalizing every frame to the lowest silhouette pixel.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native leg and tail gait; omit duplicate loop endpoint.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native raised-claw windup, forward lunge and recovery; no hand-painted strike effect.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native open-mouth special release; no separate projectile asset.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native crouched resting pose; source eyes appear open at auditioned pose.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native broad forelimb/tail swing; no weapon invented.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two cycles of the native claw attack; PMDO XML has one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native full-body Hop and tail motion; retain whatever lift source supplies.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native braced pose into raised-claw/mouth expression and recovery; no invented energy effect.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native look/stance motion with whole-view yaw; endpoint excluded.
